content:
In the middle of the massive Best Buy 60th anniversary sale, AirPods Pro 3 are still 25% off this week, all five colors of AirPods Max 2 are down by $120, and the AirTag 2 all-time lows are still going strong; however, there are also some fresh deals to check out in today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break. If you're looking to move fast, Apple's official refurbished store just restocked, with the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue down to $1,099, and we're also tracking a batch of brand-new M5 Pro MacBook Pros down by $400. The $100 off Apple Watch Series 11 deal has also returned, starting at $250, and we have deals on Twelve South accessories — their Find My charger and Curve Nano MagSafe stand have hit new Amazon lows. See all the details below.

AirPods deals drop further, up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more

After a whole summer of steady deals on Apple's newest AirPods lineup, nearly every model has dropped another notch. The sought-after AirPods Pro 3 are now going for one of the best prices ever, down 25%; the AirPods 4 with ANC have also fallen to their lowest price in months; and AirPods Max 2 dropped again this morning, $120 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)

AirTag 2 back down to all-time low of $22 and up (4-pack and single)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 "Premium" open-box $20 (originally $29 new) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (originally $99)

Best Buy launches 1-day anniversary LG deals: TVs from $330, $600 off 2026 OLED models, more

Restocked: Cheapest M5 MacBook Air at $1,099 via Apple refurbished store, while supplies last ($200 off MSRP new)

Update 8/20: This deal is now back in stock at $1,099 in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This deal may not last long — it never does — but Apple's official refurbished store just restocked, with the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue down to $1,099 shipped.

This particular configuration sells out fast every time Apple restocks it, so if you're interested, don't hesitate — after all, it's the lowest price on an M5 MacBook Air.

Apple's official certified refurbished store is now selling a 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,099 shipped. As mentioned above, Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue colorways are available as of writing.

This machine is originally $1,299, which is $200 off the new MSRP.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

As a reminder, all products at Apple's official refurbished store come with the following coverage:

  • Apple 1-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare
  • Rigorous refurbishment process carried out by Apple before sale

By comparison, Amazon's pricing for this brand-new model is very close to the $1,299 MSRP, with the Silver version down to $1,240.

Amazon still offering steady $400 off M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations

As part of the 60th anniversary sale, Best Buy held a special 1-day-only Apple event yesterday. The highlight was $400 off two M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations, but if you missed it, Amazon still has both of those deals today.

Amazon is still selling these two 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pros for $400 below MSRP — one with base CPU/GPU specs, the other upgraded to an 18-core/12-core configuration.

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (originally $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (originally $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

These are indeed the same deals we featured yesterday, but it looks like they may only last 1 day — that's what Best Buy said, and we don't know if Amazon will follow suit. Overall, Amazon could pull these deals at any time, but they're still live as of writing, and we want to make sure you don't miss them.

This 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $400 off today

B&H is now selling a 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB RAM and 1TB storage for $2,699 shipped.

This configuration is originally $3,099, which is $400 less than buying directly from Apple.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary week deals at $100 off, Best Buy open-box from $254

Although yesterday's 24-hour 60th anniversary Apple event has ended, there are still plenty of great deals. Beyond AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, AirPods Max 2 at $120 off, and all-time lows on Apple's latest AirTag 2, we're also tracking $100 off most of the cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 models on Amazon and Best Buy, with "Premium" open-box starting as low as $254.

Amazon is once again selling all base 46mm Series 11 models for $329 shipped. That's $100 off the $429 MSRP, and all four case colors are available at this discounted price.

However, inventory of the smaller and cheaper 42mm version is nearly completely sold out. At this point, you have to turn to Best Buy.

Their massive 60th anniversary sale is running all week, with all 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 models in stock and selling for $100 off MSRP.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

Although the price difference isn't huge, I also want to mention the "Premium" open-box deal on the Jet Black 42mm model — $253.99 shipped, which is $145 less than the new MSRP. That's only $45 less than buying a brand-new unit, but $45 is nothing to sneeze at, and this is the lowest price we've found at a reputable retailer.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models are $220 off today (matching Prime Day deals)

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple refurbished store feature, you can get a perfectly functional iPhone 16 starting at $699 with a 1-year Apple warranty; there's also a 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,269 — that's $330 less than a comparable 17 Pro Max and $130 less than a 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 less than the 17 series)

The Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the nicest MagSafe stands I've ever seen, grab it for $27 (originally $35)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Twelve South's all-in-one braided PowerCord USB-C charger down to $16.50 (45% off)
  • 5TB for just $180? WD Elements portable hard drive sees rare discount to lowest since storage price hikes (today only)
  • Woot's latest Keychron mechanical keyboard sale starts at $20, up to 64% off
  • This 14-in-1 Anker Prime docking station is $100 off, hitting a new low
  • This Anker 8-outlet power strip with USB and surge protection is $22 today
  • Upgrade your home theater reactive lighting experience with the Govee TV Backlight 3 Lite kit, starting at $110, more models from $60
  • Petcube Cam 360 monitors your pets 360 degrees with two-way talk for $35
  • Govee's latest Matter-equipped Floor Lamp 3 Lite is $85, other models from $80 up to 47% off
  • Anker Nano 100W 3-port charger with 5-foot cable is $36 today

Amazon now has all five colors of AirPods Max 2 down by $120 (one of the best prices ever)

This week's massive 60th anniversary sale has brought one of the best prices on Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now selling all five colors for $120 below MSRP.

Amazon is now selling the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 shipped.

Priced the same as the previous generation at $549, that means you save a solid $120, which is the lowest price we've found on a brand-new unit at a reputable retailer right now.

Best Buy does have a "Premium" open-box Midnight black version selling for $403.99 shipped, which is cheaper, but may not be low enough to justify giving up a brand-new unit.

Apple launched a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, rather than just a color refresh and a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, next month's new products won't update its over-ear lineup, so what we're facing now is a $120 discount on the latest Apple over-ear headphones for the foreseeable future.

The only previous promotion that offered a lower price was Prime Day earlier this summer, when the selling price was $30 lower than today's deal price — but inventory was very limited and unstable during that four-day event.

Anker 45W Nano Smart Display charger still at $26 low, but this bundle adds a USB-C cable for just $4 more

As part of the ongoing 60th anniversary sale, Best Buy is selling the white Anker 45W Nano Smart Display charger plus Nano USB-C cable bundle for $29.99 shipped. That's only about $4 more than the charger's current discounted price of $25.99 shipped, which Amazon and Best Buy are still selling at. Considering that the Nano USB-C cable in the bundle typically sells for around $18 on its own, that means you're essentially paying just $4 to add the cable to the charger — this is really a great value combo. See more details below.

  • Anker Nano 45W GaN Smart Display charger $25.99 (originally $40)
  • Black
  • Blue
  • Orange
  • White

One of the standout features of the Anker 45W Nano charger is the built-in Smart Display, which can identify supported devices, such as iPhone and iPad Pro models, and automatically adjust power delivery. The screen also displays real-time charging information and animations, so you can clearly see the status while your device is plugged in. It features a top-mounted USB-C port with up to 45W output, plus 180-degree foldable prongs for everyday use or travel. Anker offers four colors, including an orange option that complements Apple's Cosmic Orange devices. This bundle includes the Anker Nano USB-C cable for just $4 more. This braided cable supports up to 240W charging and 480Mb/s data transfer, making it overall a pretty solid choice. If you're looking to buy a new reliable cable for charging your phone, this bundle is really worth it.

Other Anker deals worth noting

  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (originally $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging stand with display $135 (originally $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch control $116 (originally $150)
